chunks: I also stand witness that Muḥammad — the peace and blessings of Allāh be upon him and his progeny — is His slave and His Messenger, chosen from His creations, selected for detailing His realities, picked for His selected honours and chosen for His esteemed messages. Through him the signs of guidance have been lighted and the gloom of blindness (misguidance) has been dispelled.
ai.seo_question: What are the attributes of the Prophet Muḥammad as described in the witness testimony of Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In the context of Nahj al-Balagha’s discourse on the transience of the world, this shahadah serves as the theological anchor, affirming the Prophet’s unique status as the 'chosen one' (al-Mujtaba) whose divine election ensures the clarity of guidance amidst worldly decline. This declaration underscores the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s intrinsic purity and selection, linking his role as the conduit of truth directly to the preservation of faith against the corrupting influences of temporal existence.
